seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,wall] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,y x1, pixels x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Stateless frame-native rule: 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks; H axis = block row, V axis = block col (wall 10), pieces ring 5, targets solid 11.
Each piece block mirrors across V, H and both into solid 4 (skip on-axis sources, off-board and piece cells); stack piece>reflection>target>walls.
A5 cycles selection H -> V -> pieces by min block -> H (selected shows 0 centres); A1/A2 move H or piece vertically, A3/A4 move V or piece horizontally.
Hypothesis 'reflection A3 [player,wall] mixed' = A3 moves the V axis/piece and its mirrors follow (re-extraction); no clicks involved.
HUD col 63: one cell -> 12 per effective action. Unconfirmed: piece sitting on an axis row (never observed).
